projects.title: AI Support Triage — a production agent
projects.summary: An agent that took over support-ticket triage and ran the full loop in production, with human sign-off.
projects.description: I built an agent that took over support-ticket triage: it classified each ticket, investigated it, and drafted the fix and the customer reply, running the full loop in production with human sign-off on every action. The hard part was never the model, it was trust. I built a golden set of previously resolved tickets it had never seen and measured handling accuracy against known-good resolutions (about 84%); routing accuracy improved from 54% to 76%. Every human correction fed back as new evaluation data, and an observe-then-enforce rollout expanded autonomy only as the numbers earned it.

media.title: Claim-to-spec flow
media.description: How a raw ticket becomes a classified, investigated, drafted resolution.
